description: Ask a person a question with 2-4 tappable options, then block on their answer (pair with wait_for_answer). Delivered as a push they can answer from the lock screen or in-app; the first valid answer wins. Rate-limited.

attachment_ids.description: Ids of up to 4 uploaded attachments (see upload_attachment) to include. Uploading requires a Pro account.

context.description: Optional secondary line, e.g. a build number.

correlation_id.description: Your own id, echoed back unchanged on read.

data.description: Arbitrary structured context (max 25 keys / 8KB). Read surfaces return it after connector privacy filtering; do not put secrets in data. data.location is reserved for a shareable location.

label.description: Optional place name shown to the recipient.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key so a retried call cannot create a second one.

options.description: Answer options in display order. Omit for a default Approve/Deny.

label.description: Button text shown to the person.

style.description: primary = affirmative (brand color), danger = destructive (red), default = quiet.

value.description: Stable token returned as the answer.

reply_to.description: Optional routing pointer, echoed back unchanged.

text_input.description: Invite a typed answer (on its own, or alongside options). max_length is capped at 60.

placeholder.description: Hint shown in the reply field.

ttl.description: Seconds the question stays open before it expires.

name: ask_question

result.description: Purpose-built PingRoom result with credential and account fields removed.

title: Ask Question
